name: Offshore wind (fixed bottom)
principle: Large turbines on monopile or jacket foundations in water shallower than 60 m, connected by export cables or HVDC links. NREL's 2024 baseline representative turbine is rated 12 MW with a 216 m rotor and 137 m hub height; near-term costs are higher than earlier projections.

process_steps.name: Inter-array cables to an offshore substation
Export cable to shore, AC or HVDC

performance.basis: 216 m rotor, 137 m hub height, base year
